methods_quotes.q: The proportion of persons who received a second JYNNEOS vaccine dose was calculated from among all persons who received a first dose
Persons were considered to be due for their second dose if they received their first dose ≥28 days earlier.
The interval in days between first and second doses was calculated using date of administration for each dose.
